hlg.name: Enable Citizen Participation in Urban Management
hlg.description: Allow citizens to report urban issues such as potholes, broken streetlights, or garbage, fostering civic engagement and improving public services through direct feedback.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable citizens to submit urban issue reports with detailed metadata and track multiple reports for real-time updates and resolution progress.

hlg.name: Provide Transparent and Accessible Reporting System
hlg.description: Ensure citizens can view reports on an interactive map and summary table, with filtering and sorting options, to increase transparency and awareness of urban issues.

branches.hlg_prime: Citizen interacts with a public interactive map to view and filter reports by category, status, or location, and sort them according to specified criteria.

hlg.name: Support Real-Time Communication Between Citizens and Municipal Staff
hlg.description: Enable citizens to receive notifications and messages regarding their reports, and allow staff to communicate updates and comments, building trust and accountability.

branches.hlg_prime: Citizen can view the status and receive notifications about updates for submitted reports.

hlg.name: Allow Non-Registered Users to Access Public Information
hlg.description: Enable anonymous users to view public statistics and the interactive map of reports to promote public awareness and encourage civic involvement without requiring registration.

branches.hlg_prime: Provide public, anonymous access to aggregated report statistics and an interactive map of report locations without requiring user authentication.

hlg.name: Ensure Efficient Review and Approval of Citizen Reports
hlg.description: Enable the Organization Office to review, approve, or reject citizen reports with mandatory explanations for rejections, ensuring accountability and quality control.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable citizen report review and decision-making with mandatory justification for rejection by organization office staff.

hlg.name: Facilitate Report Assignment and Management Based on Category
hlg.description: Allow Technical Office Staff to assign reports to appropriate departments or external companies based on category, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of urban issues.

branches.hlg_prime: Assign reports to appropriate departments or external companies based on report category, with technical office staff as the assigning actor.

hlg.name: Provide Public and Private Statistical Insights
hlg.description: Offer public statistics on report trends and categories, and private analytics for administrators to monitor system performance and resource allocation.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable Municipal Administrator to view both public report statistics and private system performance analytics for comprehensive oversight of report trends and system resource allocation.

hlg.name: Make Participium Open-Source and Available to All Italian Public Administrations
hlg.description: Ensure the system is released as open-source software and made available through https://developers.italia.it/ to promote interoperability and scalability across Italian public administrations.

branches.hlg_prime: Prepare and publish a municipal system as open-source software on https://developers.italia.it/, including configuring system settings for release and executing the public publication.
